sources.label: Morphe patches for mobile phone apps: skip ads, block tracking, and more.
sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Block analytics & tracking
Stops Adobe, Amplitude, AppsFlyer, CleverTap, comScore, Kochava, Nielsen, and Firebase Analytics.
Dark mode
Lets Android darken the app while the phone is in dark mode. Android picks the colors, so some screens may look different from a designed dark theme.
Fix launch with DNS blockers
Opens the app when a DNS blocker stops OneTrust, the app's privacy consent service. Without it, the app stays on its splash screen.
Hide newsletter pop-ups
Hides the newsletter sign-up bars that ask for your email address in articles.
Hide premium promotions
Removes the "Premium Content" subscription card and its "Latest Episodes" heading from show pages.
Hide prompts and pop-ups
Hides the prompts and pop-ups you choose in the patch options.
Route traffic through a proxy
Sends the app's network traffic through a proxy you choose, such as Orbot or a VPN service's SOCKS5 server.
Skip ads
Removes the banner, in-feed, and article ads, and skips the ad breaks in on-demand videos.

sources.label: Patches for Android TV streaming apps
sources.author: TV
patch_list: Block analytics & tracking
Stops the analytics, audience-measurement, and attribution services in the app and its web pages.
Disable auto-updates
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Hide device identifiers
Hides details about your device from the app. Choose which ones in the patch options.
Skip ads
Removes the ads in on-demand clips. Ads in the live stream still play.
